Newry City Athletic Football Club, referred to as Newry City, are a semi-professional Northern Irish football club competing in the NIFL Championship, having been promoted from the NIFL Premier Intermediate League in May 2026. They also compete in the Irish Cup.\nThe club is based in Newry, County Down and plays at the Showgrounds on the south eastern outskirts of the city. Newry City are a part of the Mid-Ulster Football Association. The club's colours are blue and white, with the jersey ordinarily employing blue and white vertical stripes.
